ns2:section.sectionText: Languages and Cultures of the Mediterranean - For thousands of years the Mediterranean Sea has been a place where important civilizations meet, where cultures and languages intermingle and compete. This course is an introduction to the social and cultural history of languages spoken around the Mediterranean, a substantive program of study that provides a detailed contemporary and historical survey of over a dozen languages and many dialects, and their communities of speakers. Instructor: Eda Derhemi No pre-requisite, non-repeatable
